rows.answer: The weight of the ResMed AirSense 11 with its standard humidifier tub is 1130 grams or 40 ounces (AirSense 11).

The operating pressure range of the DreamStation CPAP is 4-20 cm H2O (DreamStation CPAP). This pressure is measured at the mask (Mode pressure range CPAP). The device can operate in CPAP mode with this pressure range, and when using the EPR (Expiratory Pressure Relief) feature, the pressure range remains 4-20 cm H2O, though EPR reduces the pressure during expiration by 1.0, 2.0, or 3.0 cm H2O depending on the level set, with the delivered pressure not dropping below 4.0 cm H2O (Mode pressure range CPAP).
The sound pressure level of the Resvent iBreeze CPAP is 28 dB (iBreeze CPAP System). The measurement has an uncertainty of 2 dB (iBreeze CPAP System).
The warranty period of the DreamStation CPAP device is 2 years (DreamStation CPAP). The warranty is specifically for the US region (DreamStation CPAP).

The knowledge graph does not explicitly state the specific ramp time setting value for the DreamStation CPAP. However, it does provide information about the Smart Ramp feature on DreamStation devices. The Smart Ramp feature on the DreamStation CPAP Pro has a time range of 0 to 45 minutes with 5-minute increments (DreamStation CPAP Pro, Smart Ramp). The DreamStation CPAP Pro also indicates that the starting ramp pressure is "Patient adjustable" (DreamStation CPAP Pro). The graph does not specify a default ramp time value specifically for the DreamStation CPAP model.
The maximum water capacity of the ResMed AirSense 11 humidifier tub is 380 mL (Water Capacity, AirSense 11).
The operating altitude range of the ResMed AirStart 10 CPAP is Sea level to 2,591 m (AirStart 10 CPAP). This is equivalent to approximately 8,500 feet.
The typical power consumption of the ResMed AirSense 11 is 9.0W (AirSense 11). The peak power consumption is 71.9W (AirSense 11).

The knowledge graph does not contain information about the dimensions of the Fisher & Paykel SleepStyle 200. While the graph indicates that the Fisher & Paykel SleepStyle has a "quiet, compact, discreet" design (Fisher & Paykel SleepStyle) and that the SleepStyle 200 Series is similar to the Fisher & Paykel SleepStyle, no specific dimensional measurements (such as height, width, depth, or weight) are provided for either device.

The data storage capacity of the DreamStation CPAP SD card is greater than 1 year (SD Card, DreamStation CPAP, DreamStation CPAP Pro). The SD card can record and save patient treatment data with a storage capacity threshold of 200MB (SD Card).

The knowledge graph lacks specific weight information for the ResMed AirStart 10 and the ResMed AirSense 11 that would allow for a direct comparison. 

The AirStart 10 CPAP has a weight of 1106 g (AirStart 10 CPAP). The AirSense 11 has a weight listed as 1130 g for both the device with standard humidifier and with cleanable humidifier (AirSense 11). 

Based on these values, the ResMed AirStart 10 at 1106 g is lighter than the ResMed AirSense 11 at 1130 g by 24 grams.

The Resvent iBreeze is quieter than the Loewenstein prisma SMART. The iBreeze CPAP System has a sound pressure level of 28 dB (iBreeze CPAP System), while the prisma SOFT plus (which is part of the same product line as the prisma SMART) has a sound pressure level of 26 dB at 10 hPa (prisma SOFT plus). However, it's important to note that the graph does not contain specific noise level data for the prisma SMART model itself - only for the prisma SOFT plus variant.

The ResMed AirSense 11 tolerates a higher operating altitude. The AirSense 11 has a maximum operating altitude of 3010 m (AirSense 11), while the AirStart 10 CPAP has a maximum operating altitude of 2591 m (AirStart 10 CPAP).

The ResMed AirSense 11 has the larger humidifier water capacity. The AirSense 11 has a water capacity of 380 mL (AirSense 11, Water Capacity), while the Resvent iBreeze has a water capacity of 290 mL (iBreeze CPAP System).

The DreamStation CPAP is heavier with its humidifier. The DreamStation CPAP with humidifier weighs 1.98 kg (DreamStation CPAP). The graph lacks the weight specification for the BMC RESmart Auto CPAP with humidifier, so a complete comparison cannot be made. However, the RESmart CPAP (a related model) weighs 2.4 kg with humidifier (RESmart CPAP), which would actually be heavier than the DreamStation CPAP. Without the specific weight data for the BMC RESmart Auto CPAP with humidifier, the question cannot be definitively answered.

Based on the knowledge graph, the dimensions of the Resvent iBreeze are: length 238 mm, width 178 mm, and height 128 mm (iBreeze CPAP System). However, the graph lacks specific dimension information for the Fisher & Paykel SleepStyle 200. While the Fisher & Paykel SleepStyle is described as having a "compact" design (Fisher & Paykel SleepStyle), no explicit measurements are provided for the SleepStyle 200 Series.

The DreamStation CPAP offers a longer ramp time. The DreamStation CPAP Pro has a smart ramp time range of 0 to 45 minutes with 5-minute increments (DreamStation CPAP Pro), and the DreamStation CPAP has a ramp time range of 0 to 45 minutes with 5-minute increments (DreamStation CPAP). In contrast, the knowledge graph does not explicitly state the ramp time range for the Resvent iBreeze CPAP System, though it does have a Ramp Time feature (iBreeze CPAP System). Based on the available information, the DreamStation CPAP's maximum ramp time of 45 minutes can be confirmed, while the iBreeze's specific ramp time duration is not provided in the graph.

The ResMed AirStart 10 is quieter than the ResMed AirSense 11. The AirStart 10 has a sound pressure level of 26.6 dBA (AirStart 10 CPAP), while the AirSense 11 has a noise level of 35 dBA (Noise Level, AirSense 11). Both measurements have an uncertainty of ±2 dBA.

On the DreamStation, SmartRamp mode differs from standard ramp mode in how it adjusts pressure. SmartRamp is an intelligent ramp mode that automatically adjusts pressure based on patient breathing patterns (SmartRamp), whereas standard ramp uses a fixed time-based pressure increase (SmartRamp). Specifically, SmartRamp maintains a constant lower pressure until the device detects that you require more pressure (DreamStation), rather than simply increasing pressure gradually over a set time period. The standard ramp function reduces pressure and then gradually increases the pressure to the prescription setting over time to help you fall asleep more comfortably (Ramp). SmartRamp is similar to AutoRamp (SmartRamp), which senses when the user falls asleep and adjusts ramp time appropriately (Auto Ramp).

The ResMed AirSense 10 AutoSet for Her is the device that has a therapy algorithm designed specifically for women (ResMed AirSense 10 AutoSet for Her, AirSense 10 AutoSet for Her). This device features the AutoSet for Her algorithm, which is the first dedicated algorithm designed to treat obstructive sleep apnea in female patients (AutoSet for Her algorithm). The algorithm is specifically designed to respond to female-specific characteristics of sleep apnea, addressing the higher instances of flow limitation often seen in women (AutoSet for Her algorithm, ResMed AirSense 10 AutoSet for Her). It sensitively detects flow limitation early to apply pressure changes steadily and comfortably throughout the night with minimal sleep disturbance (AutoSet for Her algorithm).

The purpose of the EZ-Start feature on the DreamStation CPAP Pro is to provide automatic, personalized adjustments to CPAP pressure designed to help patients gradually acclimate to their prescribed level of therapy (EZ-Start). Specifically, EZ-Start enhances patient acclimation (EZ-Start) and provides personalized adjustments (EZ-Start) to make the therapy more comfortable during the initial adaptation period.

The 135-degree angle in the submersed tubing of the Seattle-PAP Bubble CPAP system increases the amplitude of oscillations, thus providing effects similar to high frequency oscillatory ventilation for improving gas exchange and offering more efficient respiratory support compared to other methods of noninvasive respiratory support (Seattle-PAP). This design feature creates pressure oscillations that improve gas exchange and reduce respiratory muscle work (Bubble CPAP Therapy). The vibrations from bubbling help contribute to gas exchange and reduce the infant's work of breathing (Bubble CPAP).

The ResMed AutoRamp feature relies on sleep onset detection to know when to ramp up to the prescribed pressure (AutoRamp with sleep onset detection, Auto Ramp). The feature is designed to begin by delivering a low start pressure to help the patient fall asleep with ease, and then it responds by comfortably ramping up to the prescribed pressure the moment it detects sleep onset (AutoRamp with sleep onset detection). This intelligent detection system allows AutoRamp to automatically sense when the user falls asleep and adjust the ramp time appropriately (Auto Ramp).

On the ResMed AirSense 11, the EPR (Expiratory Pressure Relief) feature gently lowers the pressure delivered when you exhale, making it easier to breathe out against the air pressure (Expiratory pressure relief, EPR). Specifically, EPR provides adjustable pressure reduction during exhalation with three levels: Level 1 reduces pressure by 1.0 cmH2O, Level 2 by 2.0 cmH2O, and Level 3 by 3.0 cmH2O (EPR). The feature requires a minimum pressure of 4.0 cmH2O to operate (EPR). When EPR is enabled, you may find it easier to breathe out (EPR).

The knowledge graph does not explicitly state the sound pressure level in decibels for the Fisher & Paykel SleepStyle 200. However, there is a general "sound pressure level" entity with a value of 27 dBA (sound pressure level), measured according to ISO 80601-2-70:2015 and ISO 80601-2-79:2018 standards with an uncertainty of 2 dBA. Additionally, there is a "Noise Level Standard" that specifies an acceptable noise range (Sound Pressure Level) of less than 28 dB at 10 hPa/cmH2O at a distance of 1 metre (Noise Level Standard). The SleepStyle 200 Series is manufactured by Fisher & Paykel Healthcare (Fisher & Paykel Healthcare, SleepStyle 200 Series), but the graph does not explicitly attribute the 27 dBA value to this specific device model.
